title: Pairwise Taxonomy Mapping
description: For describing how clusters (and higher-level classes of cells) are related between two cell type taxonomies.

taxonomy.description: This file does not contain complete info about each taxonomy's taxons. It is expected users can find complete info at the url specified in this object.

data_file_url.description: File where someone can access the single-cell data to replicate creating overlap metrics.

mapping.description: For taxons in taxonomy A, which taxon(s) in taxonomy B are related. If a taxon in taxonomy A is not related to any taxons in taxonomy B, it should NOT be included in this list; omissions are information.

related_taxons_in_B.description: There can be 1:many relationships for a given taxon.

taxonomies.description: The two taxononmies A and B mapped to each other.

datasets.description: List of single-cell datasets used to compute the 'overlap' metrics, i.e. how many cells labels as taxon_A were also labeled as taxon_B.
